cc:Work.dc:title: Observed cost-accuracy operating points
cc:Work.dc:description: Source: data/current_results.json; SHA-256 94761abdea412dc2b3d59222a7941ba93768a1929c772f87743c08bdab33b67b. Posterior and vote curves: observed Pareto grid points; fixed stream: all observed budgets. Segments are visual guides. Accuracy displayed as percentage; single-model reference is post-hoc strongest evaluation arm.
